name: AirPlay 2 Multi-Room
description: Turns the kiosk into an AirPlay 2 speaker that groups with HomePods and other AirPlay 2 speakers for multi-room audio from an iPhone, iPad or Mac. Follows the sender's clock over PTP, which needs Shizuku running as root. Shows track info and cover art, publishes playback to Home Assistant and lowers audio while the voice assistant talks. Audio only. Not affiliated with Apple.
author: Ian White

settings.title: Speaker name
settings.description: The name shown in the AirPlay menu on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Leave empty to use this kiosk's device name.

settings.title: Audio offset
settings.description: Shift AirPlay audio later (positive) or earlier (negative) to line it up with video or other speakers. Applies straight away.

settings.title: Lower AirPlay while the assistant talks
settings.description: Turn AirPlay audio down while Voice Satellite listens and answers.

settings.title: Wake the screen when playback starts
settings.description: Dismiss the screensaver and turn the display on when AirPlay audio starts.

settings.title: Floating player
settings.description: A card with the track, artist, cover art and progress over the dashboard: for a few seconds when a track starts, or for as long as AirPlay plays. Tap it to open the full-screen view.

settings.title: Full-screen view
settings.description: Large cover art and track details filling the screen. "When the screensaver starts" shows it in place of the screensaver while AirPlay plays, like Kiosk Satellite's own Now Playing. "Right away" also opens it as soon as playback starts.

settings.title: Start Shizuku as root at boot
settings.description: Multi-room needs Shizuku running as root, and Shizuku stops when the kiosk restarts. On, the plugin starts it at boot through this device's own ADB, as adb root and adb shell would from a computer. Needs Rooted debugging and ADB over network on port 5555. The plugin keeps its own ADB key on this device.

settings.title: Port
settings.description: TCP port for AirPlay connections, 1024 to 65535. The default keeps clear of Kiosk Satellite's own AirPlay receiver.

settings.title: AirPlay device ID
settings.description: Generated on first start. Clear it to make Apple devices see this kiosk as a new speaker.

settings.title: Feature flags
settings.description: For troubleshooting only. Leave empty for the default (0x401FCA00,0x1C340, as shairport-sync advertises). See the README.

settings.title: Shizuku start command
settings.description: Leave empty to find Shizuku's starter automatically. Otherwise paste the command from Shizuku > Start via connected computer > View command.

settings.title: Shizuku is running as root
settings.description: Set by the plugin to switch the Shizuku button between Start and Started. Changing it here has no effect.

buttons.title: Start Shizuku now
buttons.label: Start
buttons.description: Starts Shizuku as root the same way the boot start does. The first time, approve the "Allow USB debugging?" prompt on the kiosk screen with Always allow.

buttons.title: Shizuku is running
buttons.label: Started
buttons.description: Shizuku runs as root. Tap to check that the boot start can still reach ADB as root.
